title: Urine test
what: You collect morning urine in a small container at home and bring it to the lab. It shows how your kidneys work and whether there is inflammation.
why: For checkups, pain in the lower belly or lower back, frequent or painful urination, pregnancy, and diabetes.
duration: collecting takes 2 to 3 minutes at home, and results usually come the next day
tell_doctor: What medicines and vitamins you take
If you are a woman and have your period now. The test is usually moved
If you recently had a catheter or a procedure on your urinary tract

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a sterile container from a pharmacy or the lab. Do not use a food jar.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Do not eat beets or foods that color your urine. No alcohol or hard workouts. Drink as usual.

prepare.title: In the morning
prepare.text: Wash with warm water, without scented soap. Women should cover the vaginal opening with a cotton ball.

prepare.title: Collecting
prepare.text: You need the first morning urine, from the middle of the stream: first few seconds into the toilet, then into the container, and the end into the toilet again.

bring: The container with urine, tightly closed and labeled
steps: In the morning, after washing, start passing urine into the toilet
Without stopping the stream, hold the container under it
Finish in the toilet and close the lid tightly
Take it to the lab within 1 to 2 hours
after: If changes are found, you are often asked to repeat the test
red_flags: Blood in your urine, or strong lower back pain with a fever: see a doctor right away

faq.q: Can I give a urine sample during my period?
faq.a: Better not. Blood gets into the sample. The test is usually moved to 2 to 3 days after your period ends.

faq.q: Can I collect urine the night before?
faq.a: No. You need fresh morning urine, and it must reach the lab within 1 to 2 hours.

reminders.text: Urine test tomorrow. Get a sterile container ready. No beets or alcohol today.
Collect your morning urine after washing, from the middle of the stream. Take it to the lab within 1 to 2 hours.
